assessment: This paper offers a novel behavioural perspective showing how opposing motivational states interact to influence behaviour differentially across individuals. It uses a variety of cutting-edge tools to dissect the microcircuits of the prefrontal cortex. This report is novel, timely, and important. It will be of broad interest to neuroscientists studying fear, reward, motivation, and decision making and is relevant to understanding neural processes in stress and anxiety-related disorders.
